iut_type: BLE peripheral device selection guidance (medical device project, via Shinko Shoji)
customer_question: We want to implement several Bluetooth profiles (BLP, HRP, HTP, HOGP, GLP, CGMP, GHSP) on our BLE module acting as a central device, and need to run interoperability/communication tests against general commercially available peripheral devices for each profile. How should we go about selecting which market-available device/model supports each given profile?
question_variants: How do we find commercially available peripheral devices that support a specific Bluetooth profile for interoperability testing?
Can you recommend specific manufacturer/model examples for each of our target profiles?
actual_issue: The customer (via reseller Shinko Shoji) was in early product planning for a medical-device-related BLE central device supporting multiple GATT profiles, and needed a practical method (plus concrete examples) for identifying real peripheral products to use as test counterparts for each profile, since the requirements were still not finalized.
plain_english_explanation: To find commercially available products supporting a specific Bluetooth profile, use the Bluetooth SIG's official product search site's 'Advanced Search' feature, filtering by the profile of interest. Prioritize results from Japanese companies if any exist; if none do, use whatever overseas manufacturer's model comes up instead. For the profiles requested, Allion identified: OMRON blood pressure monitor for BLP/HRP, OMRON Fingertip Pulse Oximeter for HTP/HOGP, OMRON Blood glucose monitor for GLP, several Sinocare Inc. continuous glucose monitor models (SE201/SP201/SZ202/SC402) and a General Life Biotechnology Co. product for CGMP, and no registered products at all for GHSP.
consultant_answer: Use the Bluetooth SIG's official product search site's Advanced Search feature, filtering by each profile, and prioritize Japanese-company results where available (falling back to overseas vendor models otherwise). Based on that search: BLP/HRP — OMRON blood pressure monitor; HTP/HOGP — OMRON Fingertip Pulse Oximeter; GLP — OMRON Blood glucose monitor; CGMP — Sinocare Inc. (models SE201, SP201, SZ202, SC402) or General Life Biotechnology Co.; GHSP — no registered products were found for this profile.
decision_logic: When a customer needs real-world interoperability test counterparts for a Bluetooth profile, the SIG's own public product registration database (searchable by profile) is the authoritative source for identifying qualified, commercially available devices, with no guarantee that every profile will have a matching registered product.
final_recommendation: For peripheral/counterpart device selection requests, search the Bluetooth SIG's official product database by profile rather than relying on general market research, and be upfront when a given profile has no registered products available.
risk_if_done_wrong: Recommending an arbitrary or unverified device as a test counterpart (rather than one confirmed via the SIG's own registered-product database) could risk selecting a device that isn't actually SIG-qualified for that profile, undermining the validity of any interoperability testing performed against it.
